## Parcel-signal design decision (the contract's open design point)

The contract bounds the input ("a committed residential-parcel/
landuse layer or a declared query against an already-ingested
residential dataset — re-confirm the concrete source at build time
against what the spine holds"). **Re-confirmation 2026-10-15:**
the claim spine holds NO parcel/landuse polygon layer (the
modeling tables — `physical_asset`/`candidate_asset`/resolution —
are empty per the P27.1 audit; no parcel dataset is registered in
`sources.toml`), so the declared input is a **committed declared
signal file**: `policy/src/policy/data/residential_parcels.toml`
carrying `signal_id`, `version`, `provenance`, a `coverage`
polygon set, and a `parcels` polygon set. The committed row-1
contents declare the signal with **empty coverage** — the honest
coverage boundary (no residential-parcel geography is held yet;
every emitted point records `unscreened`, never "clear"); the real
dataset acquisition is the P35.6 generator/registry row the
contract routes it to, not this row. The screen machinery is real
and validated at `sig-connectors validate`; tests exercise it
against a committed fixture layer
(`tests/unit/fixtures/parcels/residential_parcels.toml`).

Verdict vocabulary (`parcel_screen` field): `intersects` |
`clear` | `unscreened`. Emitted records carry `parcel_screen`,
`parcel_screen_signal` (`<id>@<version>`) and
`residential_parcel_flag` (= verdict == intersects).

## Plan

1. `policy/parcel_screen.py` + `policy/data/residential_parcels.toml`
   — the declared signal: `ParcelVerdict` enum, `signal()` cached
   loader, `screen_point(lat, lon, signal=None)`, integrity
   `signal_violations()`, and the publish-path refusal helper
   (`assert_publishable_subject` raising the refusal error).
2. Emit wiring — `dot_511._entry_from_raw` screens point records
   (intersects → `demote_for_residential_parcel` → C3, `geo_tier`
   3, coordinates withheld at emit, flag + verdict + signal
   stamped on entity + claim rows; non-point records stamp
   `unscreened`); `okc_claim`/`dossier_claim` gain
   `intersects_residential`/`parcel_screen` params + the demotion
   + stamps; `osm._normalize_asset` screens asset geometry
   (point/center) and `physical_asset_rows` withholds geometry on
   flagged rows (demotion at the ODbL surface). `flock_portal`
   emits no `sensitivity_class` and no device geometry — recorded
   N/A, nothing to stamp.
3. Publish-path refusal — `exports/shaping.py` `subject_entities`
   LEFT JOINs `candidate_asset.residential_parcel_flag`; refused
   subjects (candidate_asset or flagged) never shape a site and
   are counted honestly (`candidate_subjects_excluded`); a
   post-shape guard raises `CandidateAssetPublishRefused` (build
   error). `published_record.record_from_site_row`,
   `search_index.build_search_index`, `tiles` surface and
   `research_dossier.validate_packet` refuse the same way.
4. Fixtures + tests per the matrix below.
5. `sig-connectors validate` gains the declared-signal integrity
   check.
